Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jorge', 3: "...What I'm about to tell you is what happened that night.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory870.jpg'}
{3: 'The clock strikes midnight. The warehouse doors seal shut on schedule.'}
{3: 'Most of the lights are off to conserve power. Only a handful of cold industrial lamps remain, throwing pale light across the shelves and the main walkways.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Jorge', 3: "Tonight's outgoing shipments are five crates of ammunition, three crates of emergency rations, three sets of military power cells, and five crates of medical supplies.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "It's more than yesterday. I guess the rumors about a major deployment weren't just talk.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The terminal continuously scans and logs every item in and out. Once they are cleared, the warehouse management units begin their next round of sorting, keeping everything within easy reach.'}
{3: 'As the mechanical noise swells, a faint, ghostly light flickers to life in the darkest corner of the warehouse.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jorge', 3: "...Ma'am. Same as always, I've placed the supplies at the designated spots in each warehouse across the sector.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "You've sorted them according to my instructions, yes?", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Jorge', 3: "Yes, a portion of each item has been set aside... I've been meaning to ask, ma'am. I understand wanting ammunition and energy cells, but do Ascendants need daily necessities too?", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "You already know the answer to that. I've said it before: your only job is to supply me with supplies each cycle. As for what I'm truly after...", 4: '2'}
{3: '"No questions asked." That was the rule Amazigh set when Jorge was first handed the entire transport network.'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "I'll go clear the transport route now. After that, you can take what you need, ma'am.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'That said, the secrecy ends today...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'War is coming. Once it does, soldiers will swarm the Atlantic like ants, and no matter how resourceful I am, moving supplies out from here will be next to impossible.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "That's fair... but what do you mean the secrecy ends? You're not going to expose me, are you...?", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "I don't break my promises. Betrayal is the one thing I despise above all else. What I mean is I'll simply be taking three times the usual supplies this time.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "Three times?! They'll find out about me!", 4: '15'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'Getting caught is your problem. I never promised to keep you safe.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Besides, even if I didn't do that, someone else would expose you. Jorge...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Who's the girl hiding behind the cargo?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: 'W-what are you doing here, Kronos?! I told you to head back to camp and wait for me!', 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: 'How could I just sit there knowing my father was colluding with the enemy...?', 4: '18'}

{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "This girl has been lurking around the warehouse all morning, peeking at your ledgers and intercepting a cold shipment I had sent over. She's figured everything out, I'd wager.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: "Quite the bright daughter you've raised, Jorge.", 4: '2'}
{3: "At that moment, the phantom flames at Amazigh's side flare brighter, fully illuminating her hazel-colored face."}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "Wait, Amazigh, she doesn't know anything! She's innocent! C'mon, Kronos, tell her...", 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: "Dad, people higher up have already noticed the discrepancies. I won't let you keep going down this path.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: "Ascendant, I'm going to defeat you and clear my dad's name!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'Oh, I can clear your names... "Construct misjudged her own strength, rushed to fight off the Corrupted attacking the warehouse, and died miserably in a fire."', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1210.jpg'}
{3: 'Then the fire swallows the space whole, surging out through the windows of the warehouse and exploding.'}
{3: 'The night sky over the wasteland bleeds red.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'So Amazigh is behind all this. An Ascendant who wields fire...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Mr. Jorge... how did you make it out?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jorge', 3: 'It was Kronos. She hauled me onto a cargo bike and pushed me out just before the final explosion.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "She didn't make it out alive... I scanned for her signal when I arrived, but there's nothing. Not a trace. That poor kid is already...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Pressed for details, Jorge recounts the events of that night. By the end, he is covering his face and sobbing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "...An explosion powerful enough to level an entire warehouse. Even a Construct can't be guaranteed to walk away from that.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Or maybe it's just a damaged signal module, right? It hasn't even been that long.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'Leia, the explosion could have...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "We should find her, whether she's dead or alive, shouldn't we?!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cutting Sylph off, Leia turns to the ruins and starts hauling chunks of concrete aside. Jorge takes one look and joins in without a word.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Issarius', 3: "Setting aside Krono's fate for now... That signal issue you mentioned is worth looking into.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "What's wrong with the signal?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Issarius', 3: "Ever since we entered this area, I've had no contact with the outside.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "...The Ascendant's doing?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Issarius', 3: 'Could just be fallout from the explosion. Some of the materials in the supplies can carry compounds that interfere with communications, after all.', 4: '1'}
{3: "With his assessment made, Issarius heads back to the vehicle and takes out a weapon from the driver's seat."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Issarius', 3: "The Ascendant is still alive. I'm going to track the Punishing Virus concentration level to find a trail.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: 'What about us?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Issarius', 3: 'Stay here. Leia has a point: whether Kronos is dead or alive, finding her will help with our investigation.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "...Wouldn't a direct pursuit be faster? And do you think you can handle an Ascendant alone?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Issarius', 3: 'You never know until you try... and the Ascendant might be buried under there too, for all we know.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: 'Is that a joke?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Issarius', 3: 'A reasonable deduction.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Issarius turns and leaves without another word. Sylph takes up a defensive perimeter around the ruins, though she joins Leia in the dig before long.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "This one's too big. We'll each take a side.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Thank you.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Sylph, what's going to happen to Mr. Jorge? I've heard things about the Purifying Force...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "If he'd tried to run or resist, we would have dealt with him. But he surrendered willingly, and his crimes are tied to a much larger systemic issue.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: 'Most likely, Jorge gets interrogated and then thrown in a cell for the rest of his days.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The three sweep through the ruins from left to right, combing through every buried fragment in search of any trace of Kronos.'}

{3: "It's grueling work. The sun beats down without mercy, the wasteland stretches out in all directions, and the world bleaches into a featureless gray. The only splash of color is the two freighters moored in the distance."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "If it weren't for the Ascendant, none of this would have happened to the warehouse, to the supplies, to Mr. Jorge or Kronos...", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Sylph', 3: "Even without the Ascendant, tragedy was always going to find its way here. Jorge's sins were set in motion the moment he falsified the supply lines during the Great Evacuation.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Sylph', 3: "Just like this disaster... It's simply the weight of human sin coming back around. The world keeps sinking deeper, and every seed of evil planted will bear its fruit, sooner or later.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: 'The Punishing Virus was just the catalyst that brought it all forward sooner.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Her words carry a deep, smoldering resentment. It is a grudge against every last trace of human wickedness in this world.'}
{3: "Leia studies Sylph in silence. The heavy cloak wrapping around her, the visor hiding her expression, the fatalistic view of evil... Questions begin to spiral deep in Leia's mind."}
{2: 'Leia', 3: '...Sylph, did something happen to you?', 4: '1'}

{3: "Leia's question goes unanswered. Sylph crouches down and picks through a tangle of rebar and gravel, deliberately turning her back. The midday sun stretches her cloak into a long, dark shadow across the ground."}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "I'd rather not talk about it.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The digging continues quietly. Leia does not push further, avoiding topics of principles and personal truths.'}

{3: "Leia is not interested in talking about them. She does not want to end up in a back-and-forth where they each try to change the other's mind. Keeping things to the facts works better for everyone."}
{3: 'At last, the long search draws to a close.'}
{3: 'Every last piece of debris covering the ruins has been cleared away, leaving the concrete floor beneath fully exposed without a single spot missed.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Jorge stumbles across every open stretch of ground, his legs barely holding him up. His voice is filled with desperation.'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "I can't... I can't find Kronos anywhere.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The concrete floor of the warehouse is stripped bare. There is nothing left but scorch marks, fissures, and scattered, damaged supply crates.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "...Something's wrong.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Neither Kronos nor the Ascendant was buried under the ruins.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Then... where did everyone go?', 4: '1'}
